predict.prompt: 18 apples into 3 bags, then 2 more into each bag. One bag holds…
predict.reveal: Sharing gives 6 per bag, then each bag gains 2 more: 6 + 2 = 8.

cml.actionGoal: Divide to find one equal share, then add the amount that joins each share.
invariants: When the same amount joins every share, it is added to the size of one share after division.
misconceptions: Adding to the total before sharing, even though the story adds to each group afterward.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which numbers would have to change for the SECOND step to become unnecessary?
